P0013 continuous-replay pause repair (2026-09-16): the operator pressed '⏸ 暂停' mid-replay and nothing happened — an 11-day continuous replay always ran to the end. Two layers: (1) onExecClick's first line returns when !ctrls.exec.enabled, and the pause branch was gated on !isAdvancing, so during an in-flight step the click was swallowed before any request — and stopPlay() (which clears the play timer, i.e. 'schedule no further day') sits after that return; (2) setIsAdvancing(true) re-rendered only the status line, so the DOM kept the previously-rendered enabled look and the button lied about being clickable. Also found: when the in-flight step finishes the runner overwrites replay_runs.status with its own next.status (replay-runner-p0013.ts:766), so a PAUSED written mid-flight would be clobbered back to RUNNING. Fix (replay-view.js only, runner/route/schema untouched): pause is no longer gated by the advance single-flight lock; setIsAdvancing() re-derives the control bar; a new state.pausePending stops the play timer immediately but defers the server PAUSE until the flight ends, flushed from setIsAdvancing(false) — the single exit every flight passes — so the step is already written and cannot overwrite it; the exec slot shows '⏸ 暂停中…' while pending. Real acceptance (real Hermes, probe run 05af6048, 09-02..09-05): button clickable mid-flight, turns into '⏸ 暂停中…', and after that day's turn completes the run is PAUSED with cursor 09-03 and exactly ONE completed step — the remaining days did not run. Documented capability boundary: the in-flight day cannot be aborted (no API to cancel a Hermes turn); pause stops the days after it. Probe run deleted by id.
